description:
The memory-first coding agent

Letta Code is a memory-first coding harness, designed for long-lived agents that can learn from experience.
Instead of working in independent sessions, you work with a persisted agent whose memory is portable across models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, Kimi, and more).
What's Changed
- perf(ci): run platform tests and package checks in parallel by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4414
- feat(agent): give new subagents distinct sci-fi names [LET-12149] by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4416
- fix(api): retry message requests when a gateway returns an HTML page [LET-12476] by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4419
- test(listener): isolate Monitor cancellation notifications by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4418
- docs(skills): discover computers before denying remote access by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4420
- fix(tui): prevent malformed questions from crashing approval UI by @letta-integration[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4422
- fix(messaging): reject sends to the current conversation by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4425
- fix(listener): respect teleport ownership during approval recovery [LET-12494] by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4426
- fix(ci): run automated reviews on the CI runner [LET-12495] by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4427
- fix(listener): consume queued messages without sender holds [LET-12487] by @cpacker in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4423
- chore: bump version to 0.32.8 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/pull/4430
Full Changelog: https://github.com/letta-ai/letta-code/compare/v0.32.7...v0.32.8
